title: Notification SLA compliance — regulator and customer coverage
summary: Share of confirmed-exfil incidents whose regulator and customer notifications were completed within the applicable statutory window (NIS2 Art. 23 early warning at 24h, DORA Art. 19 initial at 4h after classification as major). Higher is better.

target.rationale: Statutory windows admit no partial-credit miss.

measurement.formula: count(notifications completed within statutory window) / count(notifications required) over window.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: incidents where __regulator_required__ or customer-notification policy applied

inputs.name: on_time
inputs.description: notifications whose emission timestamp is within the statutory window

inputs.name: on_time_cx
inputs.description: customer notifications meeting the policy window

external_refs.name: DORA Regulation Article 19 — reporting of major ICT-related incidents
